title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Everyday is Taco Tuesday when you’re in Mexico, but spare some appetite for the other heavy-hitters like chile en nogada, enchiladas, quesadillas and so much more!
In CDMX, we ate tacos at Tacos de Canasta Los Especiale in Centro (our personal favourite), La Buenavida in Roma Norte, and El Caifan in Centro.
We indulged in chile en nogada, drowned tacos, and mole at Los Panchos in Hidalgo. Mole is one of those dishes that we’d call an acquired taste.
We savoured the buffet at Cenote Ik Kil near Chichen-itza and went back to devouring tacos in Bacalar at the streetside Mr. Taco.
